result.notes: P1.5 2026-10-16: WorkspacePathRekeyTests cover literal Policy A normalization, collision preflight, no-backup/failed-backup refusal, read-only dry-run on explicit separate copies, transaction rollback and FK graph validation, repeat no-op, derived triage/handoff/federation identities, unchanged manual triage hashes, and startup guard. Command parser rejects missing/same copy database. Reports contain only keys/counts and retained-manual-key notice. Disposable fixtures only; no live apply.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The native-boundary (ToNativePath) behavior for a non-Windows host is proven against a simulated host, on Windows as well, without a host-conditional skip; the Windows-host cases keep running on a Windows host.

result.description: Per BDP v4 (MockData fixture green before production code, then Real fixture). Storage-key equivalence: C:\Users\kingd, C:/Users/kingd, c:/users/KINGD -> one key windows:C:/USERS/KINGD; \\srv\share\x and //srv/share/x -> one key keeping leading //; \\?\C:\x -> C:/x. Remote-path detection treats //srv/share as remote. ToNativePath returns backslash paths on Windows. Rekey: value mapping f(x) touches only Windows-shaped values and is idempotent; planner builds the mapping and statement plan from a scripted snapshot; executors per provider (SQLite in-memory; SQL Server and PostgreSQL provider fixtures) rewrite all workspace columns and recompute hashed values with FK validation; report counts unchanged per table and per workspace; startup guard rejects an unconverted store; rehearsal on a restored copy of McpServer_PAYTON_LEGION2 recorded as receipts. GlobalWorkspaceId for (PAYTON-LEGION2, F:/GitHub/McpServer) is stable across both input separators.
